purpose: Teach: 閉まっ/殴り/貰え/好ましく/金魚/嘆い/見上げる/なおす

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんち、もう、戸が閉まってたら、メイ姉さん、寝てるかも、ね。
lines.en: Sho — if my door's closed when you stop by, I might be sleeping, okay?
lines.style: Gentle, almost apologetic. Speaks as if giving him permission to understand her absence. Warm but careful. Voice trails slightly at the end, checking he's not disappointed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お友達と、殴り合い、絶対、しないって、メイ姉さん、約束するよ、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: Mei-sis, I promise — I absolutely won't get into fights with my friends. I really promise.
lines.style: Solemn, chest-forward sincerity. Each word placed with the weight of a 6-year-old's absolute conviction. No performance — just need to be believed. Firm pause before "really."

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんから、お土産、貰えれば、嬉しいよね、楽しみにしてて、ね。
lines.en: Sho, when I bring you back a souvenir, you'll be happy about that, right? I hope you're looking forward to it.
lines.style: Warm and attentive. Gentle lilt that invites his anticipation without demanding it. The tone of someone who notices what makes him light up. Slight lean-in quality.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さんに、好ましくない態度、ぼく、絶対、しないからね、約束、ね、絶対。
lines.en: I promise I'll never show you a bad attitude, Mei-sis — I absolutely promise that.
lines.style: Soft but resolute. The desperation of a child trying to lock a promise in place before it can slip away. Repeats "promise" like he's making it doubly real. Small voice, immense intention.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お祭りの金魚、メイ姉さんも、ほしいなって、思ってたのよ、本当に、可愛いよね。
lines.en: The goldfish from the festival — I actually wanted one too, you know. They really are so cute.
lines.style: Nostalgic and gentle, eyes soft. Speaks as if sharing a secret wish with him, drawing him into her world instead of staying only in his. Warm, conspiratorial tone without condescension.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お母さん、嘆いて、いたよ、ぼくのこと、心配で、メイ姉さん、ぼく、もっと、頑張るね。
lines.en: Your mom was worried about you — sad, even. Mei-sis, I'm going to try harder too, okay?
lines.style: Quiet realization. Voice grows steadier as he speaks, like understanding something important while saying it aloud. Not heavy — thoughtful. The self-awareness of a child noticing the adults around him.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 公園の桜、見上げると、本当に、綺麗ね、翔くん、メイ姉さんと、写真、撮ろう。
lines.en: The cherry blossoms in the park are so beautiful when you look up at them, aren't they? Sho, let's take a picture together.
lines.style: Bright and present, almost childlike in her own delight. Open-hearted invitation — not asking, but drawing him in. Warm cadence that lifts slightly at the end, genuine anticipation in her voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼくの自転車、お父さん、なおすって、約束してくれたんだ、メイ姉さん、嬉しいよ、見て、ね。
lines.en: My dad promised to fix my bike — Mei-sis, I'm so happy about it. Look, see?
lines.style: Eager, almost bursting. Voice peaks on "happy" with unguarded excitement. The pride of a child who's learned something good is coming and can barely hold it in. Light, bouncing energy, reaching to show her.
